title: Updates now come with short explainer videos
script: Whenever a feature ships, the app now automatically puts together a short video explaining what changed. You'll see a badge the next time you log in — just click it to watch a 20-second rundown. That way you always know what's new without having to hunt for it.
bullets: Short video auto-generated for every new feature
Login badge flags updates you haven't seen

title: What's-new updates now include a voiceover
script: When you open a what's-new update, you'll now hear it read aloud as the text appears on screen. The video length is matched to the narration, so everything stays in sync from start to finish. No more reading through release notes — just watch and listen.
